generation.final_prompt:
Rendering style:
Create an authored editorial illustration for a serious technology newspaper.

Direction:
- authored editorial print language
- deliberate simplified shapes with clear focal hierarchy
- restrained limited palette
- subtle physical print texture
- controlled abstraction and strong negative space
- non-photorealistic but factually grounded representation
- newspaper and social-card readability

Fixed factual and safety restrictions:
- Do not render visible text, captions, headlines, or newspaper typography.
- Do not render logos or trademarks.
- Do not fabricate visible factual evidence.
- Do not render interfaces or screenshots.
- Do not imitate a named or living artist.

Profile-specific exclusions:
- glossy CGI
- luxury product render
- generic futuristic concept art
- cyberpunk or neon
- glowing circuit-board decoration
- floating particles
- heroic centered hardware
- server rack treated as monument or skyscraper
- generic server room
- advertising composition
- airbrushed gradients
- synthetic chrome
- excessive pseudo-technical detail
- malformed or visible text
- labels
- diagrams with words

Exact source facts:
Title: AMAZON'S NEW DATA CENTER COULD BE POWERED BY ONE OF AMERICA'S BIGGEST POLLUTERS
Summary: Amazon's planned Pecos County, Texas data center will initially rely on a dedicated 7.65 GW natural-gas power project with 35 turbines. The project highlights the growing tension between rapidly expanding AI infrastructure and hyperscalers' climate commitments.

Editorial idea:
AI infrastructure growth is forcing a direct tradeoff between expanding computing capacity and meeting climate commitments.

Central subject:
Amazon's planned Texas data center and its dedicated natural-gas power project

Visual relationship:
A rapidly expanding data center depends on a large fossil-fuel power source, placing infrastructure growth in tension with environmental promises.

Composition:
Show a new industrial power complex extending toward a large data center site, with the gas turbines visibly feeding the facility while a thin line of clean horizon remains beyond it. Emphasize scale and dependency rather than portraying either side as a separate panel.

Permitted literal elements:
natural-gas turbines
power transmission lines
large data center construction site
Texas landscape
subtle heat haze or emissions from the power project

Abstraction level:
medium

Story-specific forbidden elements:
racks
chips
laptops
robots
clouds
shields
arrows
charts
skyscrapers
chess
handshakes
split-screen conflict
logos
rendered text

Likely failure modes to avoid:
Making the data center appear operational when the story describes a planned facility
Suggesting a specific emissions quantity not provided in the summary
Depicting renewable energy as part of the project
Reducing the story to a generic server facility without showing its gas-power dependency

Global factual restrictions:
Do not fabricate visible factual evidence. Do not imitate a named or living artist. Do not render interfaces or screenshots.
Do not render any words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, annotations, signage, diagrams with text, logos, watermarks, or pseudo-writing anywhere in the image.
If the concept cannot be represented without visible text, represent the relationship through shape, scale, spacing, direction, grouping, interruption, containment, or contrast instead.
